_comment: Stand-in blocks for the admin console, folded in by build_web.merge_placeholders.
Each block must declare its own `source`; a block that cannot say where it
came from cannot be badged on the page, so the build refuses it.
Emptied of blocks on 2026-08-01, when the tenant changed from the seeded
Rosa's demo to a real business. The previous `ask` block quoted
find_id 'e9b685b5' and asked about pasta pricing -- a find and a business
that no longer exist. A judge running that SQL would have found the page
describing a row the cluster does not hold, which is exactly what
The Ask panel now renders whatever the cluster actually holds, which is
nothing until the deployed Ask agent answers a real question. Refill this
